personalities.title: the Appraiser
personalities.blurb: Looks at your pockets before your face. Everything has a price and none of them are friendly.

personalities.title: the Night Clerk
personalities.blurb: Has been on shift for nine hundred years. Will ring you up the moment you stop talking.

personalities.title: the Best Friend
personalities.blurb: Calls you buddy. Remembers your name wrong on purpose. Prices are fair, which is the scary part.

personalities.title: the Lookout
personalities.blurb: Keeps one eye on the door and the other on your hands. Sells mostly things that explode or heal.

personalities.title: the Undertaker's Cousin
personalities.blurb: Gives you a good price. You won't be needing the money, and they know it.
